about.heading: About Me
paragraphs:
I'm an Industrial Physics graduate with experience across operations support, client communication, administrative coordination and digital communications.

My professional experience has taught me how to organise information, coordinate tasks, manage stakeholder communication and support the smooth execution of day-to-day activities.

At Webxiel, I worked across content operations, team coordination and performance reporting. At Sifem Global Resources, I gained experience in business research, customer engagement, account development and commercial follow-up. My experience at Nigeria Shippers Council and Solution Labs further strengthened my understanding of administrative support, documentation and client coordination.

I approach work with a focus on clarity, critical thinking and follow-through. I enjoy creating structure around tasks, keeping communication organised and helping teams move from plans to execution.

I'm currently developing my capabilities in operations management, customer experience, reporting and digital productivity tools, with a focus on building practical systems that improve how work gets done.

items.title: Operations & Reporting
items.company: Social Media Operations & Team Coordination Tracker
items.overview: Social Media Operations & Team Coordination Tracker
items.problem: Managing multiple social media platforms and content calendars requires coordination between team members, consistent scheduling, task ownership and monitoring of deliverables. Without a central tracking system, tasks and deadlines can become difficult to monitor.
items.approach:
To create a centralised system for planning content, assigning responsibilities, monitoring publishing schedules and tracking the progress of social media activities across platforms.
Tools:
Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel.
Google Docs.
Google Calendar (optional).
Click up
execution: Build a spreadsheet with:Assigned team member. Content deadline.
Approval status, Drop downs and filters and conditional formatting
A graph for daily performance of each platform being handled.
items.outcome: A centralised content operations system that improves task visibility, accountability, scheduling and coordination across  each teammate handling each social media activities.

items.title: Social Media Performance Reporting Dashboard
items.problem:
Social media activities generate performance data across multiple platforms. Without structured reporting, it becomes difficult to evaluate performance, identify trends and make informed recommendations.
At the end of the month, we can't see if there was a Growth or decline
items.approach:
To organise platform performance data into a reporting system that supports monthly monitoring, performance evaluation and decision-making.
I developed a monthly reporting system, that'd help us know if we're working on line or against our monthly targets 
Tools:
Meta Business Suite.
Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.
Microsoft PowerPoint (for presentation, it's optional).
execution: Build a reporting workbook containing: Platform. Reporting period.
Followers at the beginning and end of the period.
Content published. Engagement rate (where the required data is available).
items.outcome: The outcome resulted in a  structured reporting tool that makes social media performance easier to interpret, highlights areas requiring attention and supports more informed content decisions.

items.title: Content Strategy Development and Execution for Brand Growth
items.overview: This project combined content strategy development with execution planning to create a cohesive and effective content system.
items.problem: The brand had no defined content direction, making it difficult to maintain consistency, build identity, or connect meaningfully with its audience.
items.approach: I built a 90day strategy rooted in audience understanding, brand positioning, and content purpose. The goal was to create awareness, clarity, structure, and direction.
execution: Defined target audience and content goals
Developed content pillars aligned with brand messaging
Designed content themes and messaging direction
Ensured alignment between strategy and execution
items.outcome: The project provided a clear roadmap for content creation, improving consistency, brand voice, and overall communication effectiveness.
items.keyInsight: Strong content is not created randomly,it is built on clear strategy, structure, and intention.

items.title: Customer Experience & Client Coordination
items.company: B2B Prospect Research & Account Development Tracker
items.problem: Identifying potential business customers is only the beginning of business development. Organisations also need a structured way to understand prospective accounts, assess potential needs, organise engagement activities and monitor opportunities.
items.approach:
To develop a prospect management system that supports business research, account mapping, prospect prioritisation and opportunity tracking.
Tools:
Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.
Google Maps (for location research).
Microsoft Word (for account research briefs and proposals ).
execution: Build a tracker containing: Business name. Industry/category. Business location.
Potential product/service requirements. Relevant contact person.
Estimated opportunity (only where evidence supports an estimate).
Prospect priority. Last engagement. Current opportunity stage. Next action.
Include a simple territory overview and a summary of account engagement.
items.outcome: A prospect intelligence and account management tool that helps organise market information, prioritise engagement and support more informed business development decisions.
